purpose: Teach: アンプ/エンタープライズ/タイムズ/バーツ/カンパニー/キーパー/エコノミスト/ウィルコム

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プレゼン用のアンプ、つまりスピーカー機器を新調しましょう
lines.en: Let's upgrade the presentation setup—better speakers and amplification for the office.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Efficient pace, like moving through an agenda. Matter-of-fact tone without coldness. A slight explanatory pause on the dash, clarifying the equipment without overthinking it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。エンタープライズ版ソフトの導入を検討します
lines.en: Got it. I'll look into rolling out the enterprise version of the software.
lines.style: Quick agreement, attentive. Slight nod in the voice. Steady pace, no hesitation. Professional but warm—showing he's already thinking through the logistics.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外のタイムズ紙の取材依頼に対応しましょう
lines.en: We should also make sure we respond to that interview request from the Times.
lines.style: Forward-moving, directive but collaborative. Light emphasis on 'should'—a gentle prompt, not a command. Measured pace. Slight openness at the end, inviting his input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。タイの取引先からバーツ建ての請求が来ます
lines.en: Understood. We'll be getting invoices in Thai baht from that Bangkok client soon.
lines.style: Calm, informative. A brief pause before the details—setting up context. Level, steady delivery. The tone of someone giving information because it matters, not to impress.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外法人カンパニーとの定例会を増やしましょう
lines.en: Let's also increase how often we meet with our overseas subsidiaries.
lines.style: Clear direction, thoughtful pace. A slight emphasis on 'increase'—this is intentional, not casual. Warm but businesslike. The tone of someone who's thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料のキーパー、つまり管理担当を専任にします
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll assign a dedicated person to manage the documentation.
lines.style: Immediate, capable agreement. Slight forward momentum in the voice. Precise—he's already separating this into a concrete task. Professional confidence without arrogance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員にエコノミスト誌の購読を勧めましょう
lines.en: Let's encourage the team to subscribe to the Economist.
lines.style: Warm suggestion, not quite a directive. Gentle pace. Light touch on 'encourage'—she's not demanding, inviting them into a good idea. Slightly hopeful tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧契約のウィルコム回線を解約します
lines.en: Right. I'll handle canceling that old WILLCOM line while I'm at it.
lines.style: Decisive closure. Efficient, wrapping up. A small 'while I'm at it' ease—showing he's already thinking ahead to clear loose ends. Calm finality.
